theater: 江蘇揚州蜀岡城與運河鹽場

battle.name: 揚州之戰
battle.theater: 江蘇揚州蜀岡城與運河鹽場
battle.brief: 至元十二年(1275)冬,伯顏率元軍順江而下,圍困宋淮南重鎮揚州,築夾城、列砲,決運河水以淹城西鹽場,至次年正月城破,李庭芝戰歿、張世賢被擒不降。卡面配重投石車正對應圍城序列中以長臂重錘拋石擊城的攻城砲,與撞竿、箭車同列,決定城頭與城垛的存亡。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 揚州之戰是南宋與元朝在江淮一線的第一次決定性對撞。開戰方是元朝：至元十一年（1274）冬，世祖忽必烈以伯顏為總統，調河洛、河北之兵，會襄樊降軍與漠北騎兵，總兵力約二十萬，分荊州、揚州兩路沿江而下；軍中漢人將領眾多，行省與漢軍世侯制度供輸糧械，攻城器械中尤以西域砲匠所造「回回砲」為重器，這一類砲在襄樊之役已用過。守方是南宋：揚州屬兩淮路，歸淮東制置司節制，兼為鹽運司駐地，鹽利是兩淮軍費的大宗；城守由淮東主力兵、州兵與鹽場團練分擔，內外城垣分層設防，統制權歸朝中丞相賈似道，以總督諸路兵馬之號節制。元軍此行並非只取一城，而是要斷運河、控長江，把江南的漕運與鹽利收入版圖，故揚州必須先下。
countriesEn: The Battle of Yangzhou was the first decisive collision between the Southern Song and the Mongol Yuan on the Jianghuai line. The attacking side was Yuan: in the winter of 1274 the Kublai Khan appointed Bayan as commander in chief, drawing on the armies of Henan and Hebei, on the men surrendered at Xiangyang, and on Mongol cavalry from the northern steppe, for a total force of roughly two hundred thousand, which moved down the Yangtze in two columns, one through Jingzhou and one through Yangzhou. Many of his officers were Chinese; the provincial administrations and the Han military household system supplied grain, money and equipment; and the heaviest engine in the siege train was the huihui pao, the great counterweight stone thrower built by engineers from the western regions, a type already employed at Xiangyang. The defending side was the Southern Song: Yangzhou belonged to the Lianghuai circuits, was administered by the regional military commission of Huadong, and was at the same time the seat of the salt administration, salt revenue being a principal source of Lianghuai military finance. The garrison combined the main field troops of Huadong, the prefectural militia and levies drawn from the salt fields, with the defence laid out in depth between the inner and outer walls. Command in the widest sense belonged to the chancellor Jia Sidao at court, who held the title of supervisor of all the armies of the realm. The Mongols were not after a single town: they needed to cut the Grand Canal, to hold the Yangtze, and to take over the grain transport and salt revenues of Jiangnan, and for that reason Yangzhou had to fall first.
people: 元方領軍者是伯顏（1236—1295），巴林部蒙古人，年少時已侍忽必烈於潛邸，至元十一年拜總統將兵伐宋，是這場滅宋戰役唯一的主帥。他善於持久圍城與重砲驅逼，揚州城下的築夾城、決水灌城，據元宋兩代史籍所記皆出其意；城破之後，他遣使持檄招降兩淮郡縣，至元十三年正月率軍進抵臨安。阿術原為南宋武臣，兵敗後降元，成為伯顏帳下參贊軍務，攻城之策多出其手，決河水淹揚州一策一般認為由他主張。漢人將領董文炳、董文用父子亦隨伯顏南下，經揚州、鎮江一線轉戰，負責舟師與攻城器械。宋方最著者為鎮守州城的張世賢與總制兩淮兵備的李庭芝（史籍對其名有兩種寫法），城破之日前者被擒不降而死，後者與城共存亡；朝中丞相賈似道以總帥之號坐鎮鄂州，曾遣使議和而無結果，此役之後兵權崩解，他本人最終也淪為俘囚。
peopleEn: The Yuan commander was Bayan (1236-1295), a Mongol of the Barin tribe who had attended Kublai since the prince's days in his own household. Appointed commander in chief for the war against Song in 1274, he was the single theatre commander of the conquest of the Song. His strength lay in protracted siege and in the grinding pressure of heavy stone throwers; the double wall built against Yangzhou and the decision to drown the lower ground by opening the river dikes are, according to the Yuan and Song histories, both his work. After the city fell he sent envoys carrying proclamations to the prefectures of Lianghuai, and in the first month of 1276 he led his army to Lin'an. A-shu, originally a Song officer who surrendered to the Mongols after defeat, served as Bayan's principal adviser on siege operations; the plan to flood Yangzhou with river water is generally credited to him. Chinese officers such as Dong Wenbing and his son Dong Wen-yong marched south with Bayan, passed through the Yangzhou and Zhenjiang line, and handled the river fleet and the siege train. On the Song side the best known figures are Zhang Shixian, who held the prefectural seat, and Li Tingzhi, who commanded the forces of the two Huai circuits, the histories giving the latter's name in two slightly different forms. When the city fell the former was taken alive and refused to surrender, and the latter went down with the walls. At court the chancellor Jia Sidao, who held the title of commander in chief of all armies and was based at Ezhou, had sent envoys to negotiate and got nothing out of it; after this campaign his grip on the war effort dissolved and he himself ended up a prisoner in Mongol hands.
kits: 卡面這具配重投石車，正是本役攻城序列中那一類器械的原理：長臂一端懸掛重錘，另一端裝載石彈，靠槓桿與配重把石頭甩出，越過城牆或砸向牆頭。元軍在揚州城外列砲，連日轟擊城頭、馬道、雉堞與城內集結的守軍，所發石彈數十至百餘斤不等，單發只得一石，因此必須一日數十發不斷轟打，以消耗守軍的體力、建材與士氣，城中最吃重的正是砲火密集之處。這批砲屬「回回砲」一路，由西域砲匠在元廷主持建造，形制雖與歐洲配重投石車同源，尺度卻遠為巨大，須合數十人操作、靠牛力牽引絞索裝填。與砲陣並用的還有撞竿、飛石、箭車與可移動的攻城塔，以及木柵、壕塹、圍壘等圍城工事；對城的江面，元軍以舟師封鎖水道，斷絕糧船與援兵。城上則以床弩、弓矢、擲石與木拒馬應對，夜裡遣小隊出城焚燒砲架與築壘木料。火藥一端的火箭與藥箭亦備於軍中，襄樊之役已有震天雷一類爆破器的明確記載，揚州城下是否同樣規模施用史無明文，只可說圍城之中已備此類火器以對付守軍夜襲。
kitsEn: The counterweight trebuchet on the card is the very principle behind one of the engines in this siege train: a long arm with a heavy counterweight hung at one end and a stone loaded at the other, so that lever and counterweight hurl the stone over a wall or down onto the parapet. The Yuan army emplaced its stone throwers outside Yangzhou and hammered the parapets, the wall-walks, the crenellations and the troops massing inside the city day after day. The stones weighed from several tens to more than a hundred jin, and since a single engine discharged only one stone, the bombardment had to be kept up at dozens of rounds a day, wearing down the garrison in endurance, in timber and in morale; the places hardest pressed were exactly those under concentrated stone fire. These engines belonged to the huihui pao line, built under Yuan supervision by engineers from the western regions. Although the principle was the same as that of the European counterweight trebuchet, the scale was far greater: a whole crew of several dozen men worked the machines, and oxen hauled the ropes for loading. Alongside the artillery came battering poles, hand-thrown stones, arrow carts and movable siege towers, together with wooden palisades, ditches and encircling lines. On the river side the Yuan fleet sealed the waterways and cut off grain junks and reinforcements. From the walls the defenders answered with crossbows, bows, thrown stones and wooden cheval-de-frise, and at night they sent out small parties to burn the engine frames and the timber of the siege lines. On the gunpowder side, fire arrows and incendiary shafts were also carried in the train: there is clear record of blast charges of the thunder-crash type at Xiangyang, and whether the same scale of use was attempted below Yangzhou the histories do not state plainly; it can only be said that fire weapons were carried in the besieging force to answer night sorties.
tactics: 元軍在揚州城下打的不是一擊而破的速決戰，而是一套由外而內的消耗法。第一步，抵城之後不急攻，先在城外環城築壘，連延數十里，把揚州與江南其他州縣隔斷，使城內只能靠存量度日；同時舟師控制揚子江與運河水口，封死糧運與援兵。第二步，在城北與西側築「夾城」，即另築一道外牆緊貼原城，使宋軍原本只需守一重的城垣變成要守兩重，守軍被迫分兵，城頭的密度隨之下降。第三步，據《新元史》與地方志所載，元軍又決運河之堤放水入城西低地，鹽場與街衢一帶盡成澤國，宋軍須分兵堵築，士氣與糧秣同時受損。第四步，砲陣自遠而近連日轟擊，待城中食盡、疫氣漸起、軍心浮動，再以精兵猛攻一隅，攻城塔徐徐推進，終至城破。宋軍的應對則完全依託城垣：分段設防，城頭弓弩壓制接近的砲陣，擲石與木柵封住缺口，精兵夜出燒毀砲架，屢遣使突圍赴臨安求援，但援軍終未至。整場戰役的關鍵，是把糧道、水道與砲火三樣東西同時掐住。
tacticsEn: The Yuan army did not attempt a quick storm of Yangzhou; it worked a method of exhaustion that proceeded from the outside in. First, on reaching the city it did not attack at once, but built a line of camps in a ring around it, extending for several tens of li, cutting Yangzhou off from the other prefectures of Jiangnan so that the defenders could live only on what was stored inside; at the same time the river fleet held the mouth of the Yangtze and of the canal, sealing the grain route and the road for reinforcements. Second, on the north and west sides it built the double wall known as the jia city: a second wall run up close against the original, so that a garrison which had had to defend a single circuit now had to hold two, the defenders were forced to split, and the density of men on the parapets fell away accordingly. Third, according to the New History of the Yuan and the local gazetteers, the dikes of the canal were opened to let water into the low ground west of the city, the salt fields and the streets became a marsh, and the Song troops had to man the breaches while their morale and their provisions deteriorated at the same time. Fourth, the artillery worked closer day by day; when the food ran out, sickness spread and the garrison's nerve failed, assault troops were thrown at one sector while the siege towers were pushed forward, and the city was taken. The Song reply rested entirely on the walls: the circuit was divided into sections, bows and crossbows from the parapets kept down the approaching engines, thrown stones and wooden barriers plugged the gaps, picked troops went out at night to burn the engine frames, and messengers were sent out again and again to break through to Lin'an for relief, which never came. The key to the whole campaign was that the grain route, the water route and the stone fire were all cut at once.
data: 可核的數字有限，只列史籍常見者：元軍南征之眾，《元史·伯顏傳》記為統兵二十萬，內含漠北騎兵與漢軍步卒，分道沿江而下；揚州守軍的具體編制與人數，各家記載互有出入，只能說是淮東主力兵、州兵與鹽場團練合計數萬之眾。圍城時長，自至元十二年（1275）十一月元軍抵達城下，到翌年正月城破，約三四個月，其間砲擊「日夜不絕」。城垣形制為內外三重，外城周長以數里計。砲的效率有限，每砲一次只發一石，故攻城全靠日積月累的消耗。路程上，揚州至臨安順江而下約四百餘里，元軍舟步並進，自城破至抵達臨安亦不過十餘日。此外可注意的對比是：襄樊之役打了三年而克，揚州三數月即下，反映元軍攻城技術在這十年間的進步，也反映南宋在失去荊襄屏障之後已無縱深可恃。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are few, and only those commonly given in the histories are set down here. The strength of the Yuan invading force is recorded in the Yuan History in the biography of Bayan as a commanded army of two hundred thousand, combining Mongol cavalry with Han foot soldiers and advancing by several columns along the river. For the Song garrison of Yangzhou the exact establishment and numbers differ from source to source, and all that can be said is that the main troops of Huadong, the prefectural militia and levies from the salt fields together numbered some thousands of men. The duration of the siege ran from the eleventh month of 1275, when the Yuan army appeared below the walls, to the first month of the following year, when the city fell, that is three or four months, during which the stone fire was kept up day and night without a break. The fortifications were laid out in three circuits, inner and outer, the outer circuit measuring several li in circumference. The artillery was of limited efficiency, since a single engine discharged only one stone, and the assault therefore rested entirely on slow accumulation. As to distance, some four hundred li separate Yangzhou from Lin'an down the river, and the Yuan army moved by boat and by land together; from the fall of the city to its arrival at Lin'an took little more than ten days. One contrast is worth noting: Xiangyang took three years to reduce, while Yangzhou yielded in three or four months, which shows both how far the Yuan siegecraft had advanced in that decade and how little depth the Southern Song retained once the Xiangyang barrier was gone.
cause: 揚州之戰的直接起因，是元朝在統一漠北與北方之後把戰線推到了江淮。忽必烈自一二百六十年代起次第解決阿里不哥之亂，收編漢地州府，至元十年襄樊被元軍攻破，荊襄屏障洞開，門戶直開江漢；朝廷拒絕稱臣納歲幣，談判屢裂，戰爭遂無避免餘地。至元十一年冬，忽必烈以伯顏為總統大舉南征，兵鋒順長江而下，連下江州、池州、蕪湖、采石，一路逼近兩淮。揚州之所以必須先取，有三重實利：一是它扼古運河與長江交會之口，元軍據之，江南漕運與食鹽便在掌握；二是它是淮東的軍政與鹽運中心，取下揚州，兩淮各府縣便無險可守，可以不戰而降；三是它能作為元軍渡江的跳板與後方基地，供應舟師、馬匹與攻城器械。深層次看，這是一場宋元兩個政權在生存空間上的零和競逐：一方要保住江南的財賦與人口，另一方要完成草原與農耕世界之間最後一次大規模碰撞。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the Battle of Yangzhou was the advance of the Yuan war front to the Jianghuai once the Mongols had unified the steppe and the north. From the 1260s onward Kublai had settled the war with Ariq Qasar and taken over the Chinese prefectures one by one; in 1273 Xiangyang fell to the Mongols, the barrier of Jingxiang was broken and the way to the middle Yangtze stood open. The court refused to acknowledge suzerainty or to pay tribute, the talks broke down repeatedly, and there was no way left to avoid the war. In the winter of 1274 Kublai appointed Bayan commander in chief and launched a great invasion; the army went down the Yangtze, taking Jiujiang, Chizhou, Wuhu and Caishi in turn and pressing towards the two Huai circuits. Yangzhou had to be taken first for three practical reasons. First, it commands the junction of the old canal with the Yangtze, and a Yuan army holding it holds the grain transport and the salt of Jiangnan. Second, it is the military, administrative and salt centre of Huadong, and once Yangzhou fell the prefectures of the two Huai had no defensible ground left and would surrender without a battle. Third, it would serve as a springboard and a base for the Yuan army on the far side of the river, supplying the fleet, the horses and the siege engines. At a deeper level this was a zero-sum contest between two states for the same living space: one side meant to hold on to the wealth and people of Jiangnan, the other to complete the last great collision between the steppe and the agrarian world.
impact: 揚州陷落，等於宣告南宋最後一道可守的江淮防線崩潰。元軍據揚州而控運河，順流而下，至元十三年（1276）正月抵達臨安，宋恭帝奉表出降，南宋中央政權覆亡；兩浙、江西、湖廣、福建的州縣多望風歸附，只有潭州、廣州、福州一路還有頑抗，殘宋政權輾轉於閩海，至1279年崖山之役才真正滅亡。軍事上，揚州之役是元軍攻城術的一次示範：長圍斷糧、舟師封江、夾城逼牆、決水淹城、重砲連日轟擊，這套組合在此後攻平江、攻潭州時重複出現，中國攻城戰的面貌自此改變；同時，這也是回回砲一類西域重器第一次在長江下游的大城完整發揮，其後隨元軍東征日本、深入雲南而再無所用。經濟與城市上，揚州失去江南鹽利中心部分光輝，元廷另從海運開闢漕糧直達大都的新路，但運河沿線的鹽與糧仍倚重此城。張世賢、李庭芝一類死節者，後世以宋季忠義著稱，屢為詩文集與方志收錄，成為這場戰爭留在記憶中的另一種形式。
impactEn: The fall of Yangzhou announced the collapse of the last defensible line the Southern Song held on the Jianghuai. From Yangzhou the Yuan controlled the canal and moved down the river; in the first month of 1276 they reached Lin'an, the Song gong emperor surrendered with a memorial, and the central government of the Southern Song ceased to exist. Most of the prefectures of Liangzhe, Jiangxi, Huguang and Fujian submitted at once; only Tanzhou, Guangzhou and Fuzhou held out for a time, and the rump Song court, moving about the coastal belt of Fujian, was not finally destroyed until the naval battle at Yashan in 1279. Militarily, the siege of Yangzhou was a demonstration of Yuan siegecraft: a long blockade to cut grain, the fleet sealing the river, a double wall pressed up against the defences, water let in to drown the low ground, and heavy stone fire maintained day and night. The same combination was repeated at Pingjiang and at Tanzhou afterwards, and the face of siege warfare in China changed accordingly. It was also the first time that engines of the huihui pao type, built in the western regions, could be seen working at full stretch against a great city on the lower Yangtze; they travelled on afterwards with the Yuan armies toward Japan and into Yunnan, and were never needed again. In economic and urban terms Yangzhou lost part of its brilliance as the salt capital of Jiangnan, and the Yuan court opened a new sea route carrying grain directly to Dadu, but the salt and the grain of the canal line still depended on this city. Men such as Zhang Shixian and Li Tingzhi, who died in the defence, came to be remembered as the loyal martyrs of the last years of Song, and they recur again and again in poetry, prose collections and local gazetteers; in that form the battle entered the memory of later ages.
result: 至元十三年（1276）正月，揚州城破：守將張世賢被擒，拒降而死，統兵的李庭芝（史籍對其名有兩種寫法）與城共存亡，守軍序列瓦解，元軍入城，伯顏隨即遣使持檄招降兩淮各州縣，揚州成為元軍在江南的新據點。城破之後，元軍循江而東，取鎮江、常州、平江，至正月已抵臨安，逼出宋恭帝的降表，南宋國祚至此中斷；殘餘宋室帶帝輿渡海，最後在崖山被擊潰，至此宋元戰爭方告終局。就兵器與工程而言，這場戰役同時是配重投石車這一類攻城機械的實戰註腳：單靠砲石破不了城，唯有把砲陣、壕壘、圍城、決水與封江編為一整套，才能在三四個月內讓一座三重城垣的州府屈服；這也正是卡面那句「工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負」的意思。揚州城址今在江蘇揚州廣陵一帶，蜀岡之上仍可見宋城夯土與城垣殘基。
resultEn: In the first month of 1276 the city of Yangzhou was taken. Zhang Shixian was captured, refused to surrender and was killed; Li Tingzhi, who commanded the garrison, the histories giving his name in two slightly different forms, went down with the walls; the chain of command of the defenders broke apart, and the Yuan entered the city. Bayan at once sent envoys with proclamations to the prefectures of the two Huai, and Yangzhou became a new base of the Yuan army in Jiangnan. After the fall the Yuan marched east along the river, taking Zhenjiang, Changzhou and Pingjiang, and in the same first month stood before Lin'an and forced the surrender memorial of the gong emperor, ending the Southern Song. The surviving Song court carried the imperial household out to sea and was finally broken at Yashan, and with that the war between Song and Yuan came to an end. In terms of arms and engineering this campaign is at once the practical commentary on siege machines of the trebuchet type: stones alone will not breach a wall, and only when the artillery, the ditches, the encircling lines, the opened water and the sealed river are combined into a single system can a prefecture with three circuits of wall be brought to terms in three or four months. That is precisely what the card means when it says that engineering, more than the weapon of assault, decides the outcome first. The site of the Song city of Yangzhou lies today in the Guangling district of Yangzhou in Jiangsu, and on Shugang the rammed earth of the walls and the line of the ramparts can still be seen.
